U.S. Department of Justice 

Office of the Solicitor General 

Washington, D.C. 20530 

July 22, 2019 

Honorable Scott S. Harris 
Clerk 
Supreme Court of the United States 
Washington, D.C. 20543 

Re: Department of Homeland Security, et al. v. Regents of the University of California, 

etal.,No. 18-587; 
Donald J. Trump, President of the United States, et al. v. National Association for 
the Advancement of Colored People, et al., No. 18-588; 
Kevin K. McAleenan, Acting Secretary of Homeland Security, et al. v. Martin 
Jonathan Batalla Vidal, et al., No. 18-589 

Dear Mr. Harris: 

The Court granted the petitions for writs of certiorari in these cases on June 28, 2019. 
Petitioners' brief on the merits is currently due August 12, 2019. Oral argument has been 
scheduled for November 12, 2019. 

In order to accommodate scheduling difficulties and the press of other cases, petitioners 
respectfully request, under Rule 30.4 of the Rules of this Court, an extension to and including 
August 19, 2019, within which to file the opening brief and joint appendix. Because of similar 
concerns, counsel for respondents consent to that request and seek an extension of time for the 
filing of respondents' briefs to and including September 27, 2019. Petitioner consents to that 
request and further requests an extension of time within which to file the reply brief to and 
including October 29, 2019. Respondents consent to that request. 

Sincerely, 

Noel J. Francisco 
Solicitor General
